title: Rework Python API to be stream-based: parse_from/generate_to become load/dump, add loads/dumps
description:
Mirror the json module's conventions in the Python implementation. Rename parse_from to load and make it take a file handle (file-like object with .read()) instead of a string; rename generate_to to dump(value, fh, pretty_indent=0, json_mode=False) and have it write to a file handle. Add loads(text), which feeds a StringIO containing the text into load, and dumps(value, ...), which creates a StringIO, dumps into it, and returns its contents. Remove the old parse_from/generate_to names. Update the CLI (python/src/nrdl/cli.py), all tests (add coverage for handle-based load/dump), and the docs (reference.rst, usage.rst, index.rst, README.md). Preserve existing behavior: symbols deserialize to plain strings, true/false/null to True/False/None, dict keys serialize as symbols, pretty_indent and json_mode options, and verbatim/prose multi-line string output in pretty mode.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] nrdl.load(fh) reads one NRDL value from a file handle and load/dump are the only names in the public API (parse_from/generate_to removed)
- [ ] nrdl.loads(text) == nrdl.load(io.StringIO(text)) and nrdl.dumps(value) matches dump-into-a-StringIO output
- [ ] dump(value, fh, pretty_indent, json_mode) writes to the handle and returns None
- [ ] CLI, tests, and Sphinx docs updated with no stale parse_from/generate_to references
- [ ] Full pytest suite and Sphinx build pass
notes: Done: nrdl/__init__.py reworked to load(fh)/loads(text)/dump(value, fh, ...)/dumps(value, ...); parse_from and generate_to removed from the public API. cli.py updated to read via nrdl.load(fh) and print via nrdl.dumps. All tests migrated to the new names plus a new test_streams.py covering handle-based load/dump, StringIO equivalence, and file round-trips (335 passing). Docs (reference.rst, usage.rst, index.rst, README.md) rewritten for the stream-based API; Sphinx build passes. No stale references remain in code, tests, or docs.
close_reason: All acceptance criteria met: load/dump/loads/dumps implemented (parse_from/generate_to removed), loads==load(StringIO) and dumps==dump-into-StringIO verified by tests, dump returns None, CLI/tests/docs updated with no stale references, 335 tests and Sphinx build pass

title: Python 0.2.0: logo on ReadTheDocs, validate mode, RTD auto builds
description: Release nrdl 0.2.0 on PyPI. Includes: (1) show the nrdl logo in the ReadTheDocs docs, (2) add a --validate mode to the nrdl CLI that checks documents parse without printing them, (3) set up RTD auto builds so docs rebuild on push (GitHub Actions trigger + READTHEDOCS_API_KEY repo secret). Tag python-0.2.0, push to PyPI, rebuild RTD latest.
acceptance_criteria: Logo appears in the built docs; nrdl --validate exits 0/1 correctly and prints no data; docs rebuild automatically on push; nrdl 0.2.0 is published to PyPI
notes: Progress: logo wired into Sphinx conf.py (html_logo + favicon, verified in local build); --validate added to CLI with 5 new tests (339 passing); version bumped to 0.2.0 in pyproject.toml and conf.py; CHANGELOG updated; .github/workflows/docs.yml added to trigger RTD builds on push; READTHEDOCS_API_KEY secret set on the repo
close_reason: Done: logo on RTD (verified 200 at /_static/nrdl.png), CLI --validate mode (5 tests, 339 passing), RTD auto builds via .github/workflows/docs.yml + READTHEDOCS_API_KEY secret (workflow fired on main and tag pushes, both succeeded), nrdl 0.2.0 published to PyPI (wheel+sdist verified), RTD latest rebuilt at 1efdd480 showing nrdl 0.2.0

title: Create the ReadTheDocs project for the Python implementation and verify the build
description:
The Python docs (python/docs) and .readthedocs.yaml at the repo root are ready, but no nrdl project exists on ReadTheDocs: the API token in ~/.read-the-docs-api-key only has access to degasolv, lighthouse-scheduler, pask, and pylighthouse, and POST /api/v3/projects/nrdl/versions/latest/builds/ returns 'No Project matches the given query'.

To finish: create a project on readthedocs.org that imports github.com/djha-skin/nrdl (or repoint the API key to an account with such a project). RTD will pick up .readthedocs.yaml and build python/docs automatically on push; alternatively trigger with: source ~/.read-the-docs-api-key && curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Token ${READTHEDOCS_API_KEY}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' https://readthedocs.org/api/v3/projects/nrdl/versions/latest/builds/

The python-0.1.0 tag and PyPI publish are already done.
close_reason: Project created via POST /api/v3/projects/ (id 1189715, slug nrdl, repo github.com/djha-skin/nrdl). Build 34126032 (latest, commit 6a876d8) succeeded; docs live at https://nrdl.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ (title 'NRDL for Python - nrdl 0.1.0 documentation'). The auto-created 'stable' version points at the old 0.7.0 tag (no docs config) and cannot build; deactivated it and set default_version to latest. Note: RTD GitHub webhook for auto-builds on push may need to be added in the dashboard (Integrations) since the project was imported via API.
